description: DXF-4 golden: the audit's chassis bracket — the l-bracket-flat-pattern-view tree with FOUR Ø5.5 through holes, two drilled in the base flange BEFORE the fold and two in the wall AFTER it. Before this golden a bracket with holes exported a flat pattern of six entities and zero CIRCLEs (docs/AUDIT-PRODUCT.md 'Pass 2026-08-21 (second pass today)' S-10/S-13): a blank rectangle with two scribe lines, and scrap at the laser. The two hole positions in the tree are deliberately unequal in BOTH developed axes so a mirrored or rotated development cannot pass by symmetry, and the two drilled AFTER the fold prove the cuts are read from the LIVE body rather than the unfold's frozen clean reference.
derivation: The unfold math is unchanged and HAND-DERIVED in ../l-bracket-edge-flange/expected.json (§9 #1/#2): BA = (pi/2)*(3 + 0.44*2) = 6.094689747964199 mm, flat_length = 50 + BA + 30 = 86.0946897479642 mm. The holes do not touch a bend, so they change no fold quantity: this golden's bend table and outline are identical to ../l-bracket-flat-pattern-view.

DEVELOPED HOLE POSITIONS, hand-derived. The layout is [flange leg 0..30][BA strip 30..36.094689747964199][base 36.094689747964199..86.0946897479642] and the developed frame is right-handed on the base's outward normal (u = bend axis x n, v = bend axis), which for this body resolves to u = -x, v = -y — i.e. the blank is the part rotated 180 degrees, never mirrored. A base hole at model (x, y) therefore develops to (36.094689747964199 + (50 - x), 20 - y); a wall hole at model (y, z) develops to (30 - (z - 5), 20 - y), z = 5 being the flange's tangent line. Base (10, 5) -> (76.0946897479642, 15); base (40, 15) -> (46.094689747964199, 5); wall (y=5, z=15) -> (20, 15); wall (y=15, z=28) -> (7, 5). Radius 5.5/2 = 2.75 on all four.

flat_area = the hole-free blank's 1721.893794959284 mm^2 (../l-bracket-flat-pattern-view) minus 4*pi*2.75^2 = 95.03317777109125 mm^2 of holes = 1626.8606171881927 mm^2. This is the gate on the area reconciliation: two of the four holes post-date the last fold, so they are absent from the unfold's clean reference body, and an unreconciled development over-counts the material by exactly those two holes (47.5 mm^2 — quoted as material a shop does not cut).

solid_volume = the hole-free bracket's 3451.3274122871826 mm^3 (../l-bracket-edge-flange, itself hand-derived analytically) minus 4*pi*2.75^2*2 = 190.0663555421825 mm^3 (each hole is through 2 mm of sheet) = 3261.261056745 mm^3; measured residual 2.7e-12. Asserted so the golden cannot pass with the holes absent from the SOLID either — that gap is the audit's own falsification, which saw the holes in the body and not in the blank. Its tolerance is ../l-bracket-edge-flange's volume_tolerance (1e-6), the same arc-fit noise scaled by the 20 mm width.

A developed circle's start/end/midpoint are DERIVED from its centre and radius, not read from wherever OCCT parked the seam vertex, and a segment's endpoints are stored in lexicographic order — the two skins of one through cut bound opposite-facing faces, so OCCT walks their loops in opposite directions and raw endpoints would fail to pair (a correct rectangular cutout would be reported as a blind pocket). Both canonicalisations are visible in this hash.

content_hash is the sha256 of the flat_pattern DrawingViewResult.model_dump_json() at scale 1:1 — the same determinism pin, and version-pinned the same way, as ../l-bracket-flat-pattern-view/expected.json: the arc-fit inner radius is OCCT/build123d-version-specific FP, so a kernel bump regenerates it and a change WITHOUT a kernel bump is a determinism regression (P0), never a retry.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill), and inherited unchanged from ../l-bracket-flat-pattern-view: the bend-table residual is ~1.2e-13 (the arc-fit inner radius 2.9999999999999933 propagating into BA). The developed hole centres and radii are EXACT here — every one of the eight coordinates reproduces its hand-derived value to the last printed digit, because the map is a rigid transform of exact axis-aligned inputs — so 1e-9 leaves ~4 orders of headroom over the worst observed residual anywhere in the model while staying tighter than the standing kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m).
